content.title: PIM Configuration
content.subtitle: Protocol Independent Multicast routing
content.noInterfacesHint: Add an interface to enable PIM multicast routing.
content.noRpAddressesHint: Add a Rendezvous Point address for PIM multicast routing.

interface.title: Remove Interface
interface.description: Are you sure you want to remove this PIM interface? This will remove all PIM and IGMP settings for this interface.

rpAddress.title: Remove RP Address
rpAddress.description: Are you sure you want to remove this Rendezvous Point address? This will remove all associated multicast groups.
rpAddress.descriptionLast: Are you sure you want to remove this rendezvous point (RP) address? It is the last RP address, so this also clears the RP keep alive timer.

pim.title: Delete PIM
pim.description: Are you sure you want to delete the whole PIM configuration? This removes every PIM interface, RP address and global setting.

interfaceModal.editDescription: Modify PIM and IGMP settings for {name}.
interfaceModal.addDescription: Add a new interface to PIM multicast routing.
interfaceModal.noBsm: No BSM (do not process bootstrap messages)
interfaceModal.noUnicastBsm: No Unicast BSM (block unicast bootstrap messages)

rpModal.editDescription: Modify the Rendezvous Point configuration for {address}.
rpModal.addDescription: Add a new Rendezvous Point address for PIM multicast routing.
